title_zh: 苹果推送 iOS 27.0.1，修复 iPhone 18 Pro 面容 ID 卡死 bug
content_zh:
第一财经 9 月 28 日联系苹果客服后获悉，苹果已收到 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在面容 ID 验证时卡住、重启的用户反馈，问题已提交工程部门调查，目前，官方已推送新版系统修复。

苹果随后于今日向 iPhone 18 Pro 系列正式推送了系统更新，更新日志显示已修复面容 ID 验证时意外重启的问题。

9to5Mac 曾在一台 iPhone 18 Pro 上复现故障：使用面容 ID 解锁「密码」App 时遮挡面部，再次尝试验证后，手机停止响应并重启。这类故障发生在解锁受保护的 App 等场景，普通锁屏解锁似乎不会触发；受影响范围尚不明确。
title_en: Apple Releases iOS 27.0.1 to Fix Face ID Freezing Bug on iPhone 18 Pro
content_en:
Apple has officially rolled out the iOS 27.0.1 update to address a critical bug causing the iPhone 18 Pro series to freeze and reboot during Face ID verification. The tech giant confirmed it had received user feedback regarding the issue and quickly escalated it to its engineering department for a fix.

According to reports from 9to5Mac, the glitch could be reproduced by obscuring one's face while attempting to unlock the "Passwords" app using Face ID. This action caused the device to become completely unresponsive before triggering a reboot. The issue appears to be isolated to unlocking protected applications rather than standard lock screen unlocking, though the full extent of affected users remains unclear.

title_zh: Manus 发布 2.0，新增独立个人智能体应用 Cue
content_zh:
Manus 9 月 28 日发布 2.0 版，更新包含智能体运行框架 Cascade、可购买的云电脑、支持事件触发的自动化，以及桌面工作区 Manus Studio。公司称，在一项测试配置中，Cascade 比此前系统少用 23.2% 的 token，任务耗时减少 28.2%；这一结果来自 Manus 自测。

新推出的 Cue 是面向手机和桌面的独立个人智能体应用。按照 Manus 的介绍，用户可为每个智能体配置独立的邮箱、电话号码、钱包和电脑，使其处理消息、接听电话并在用户设定的预算内付款。Manus Studio 则提供文档、表格、网站、代码及视频等创作环境，视频编辑器允许用户直接修改智能体生成的时间线和素材。

🔗 相关阅读：突发：Manus「虎口脱险」，交出 2.0 版最新答卷
title_en: Manus Launches Version 2.0 Featuring 'Cue' Personal AI Agent App
content_en:
Manus has officially released version 2.0 of its platform, introducing major upgrades including the Cascade agent framework, purchasable cloud computers, event-triggered automation, and a desktop workspace called Manus Studio. According to internal tests, the new Cascade framework reduces token usage by 23.2% and cuts task completion times by 28.2%.

A key highlight of the release is Cue, a standalone personal AI agent application available for both mobile and desktop. Cue allows users to equip individual agents with dedicated email addresses, phone numbers, digital wallets, and virtual computers. This enables the agents to manage messages, answer calls, and make payments within user-defined budgets.

Additionally, the update introduces Manus Studio, a creative workspace designed for handling documents, spreadsheets, websites, code, and videos. The built-in video editor gives users direct control over timelines and assets generated by the AI agents.

title_zh: AMD 宣布以 82 亿美元股票收购 World Labs，李飞飞将任首席科学家
content_zh:
AMD 9 月 28 日宣布，已签署收购李飞飞创办的 World Labs 的最终协议。交易以股票支付，估值约 82 亿美元，预计在监管批准等条件满足后于 2026 年底前完成。交易结束后，李飞飞将出任 AMD 执行副总裁兼首席科学家，向 CEO 苏姿丰汇报。

World Labs 研发空间智能模型，可根据文字、图像和视频生成、重建及模拟可交互的 3D 环境，也研究机器人学习与仿真。AMD 称，收购将让芯片和系统团队更直接地了解模型在推理、机器人及物理 AI 场景中的算力需求；World Labs 团队将继续从事模型研究。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，苏妈550亿元买下李飞飞世界模型，AI 圈两位女王联手了
title_en: AMD to Acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 Billion in Stock
content_en:
AMD has announced a definitive agreement to acquire World Labs, the spatial intelligence startup founded by AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li. The all-stock transaction values World Labs at approximately $8.2 billion and is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. Following the acquisition, Fei-Fei Li will join AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, reporting directly to CEO Lisa Su.

World Labs specializes in spatial intelligence models that generate, reconstruct, and simulate interactive 3D environments from text, images, and video. The startup also conducts research into robot learning and physical simulation.

AMD stated that the acquisition will provide its chip and systems teams with deeper insights into the computational demands of inference, robotics, and physical AI. The World Labs team is set to continue its core research on advanced models under AMD.

title_zh: 4499 元起，荣耀 Magic9 系列发布
content_zh:
荣耀 9 月 28 日发布 Magic9、Magic9 Pro Max 和 Magic9 超能版，均已开启销售；同场还推出 MagicPad 4 平板和手表 6 Pro。手机系列以影像、续航和不同尺寸区分：

Pro Max 支持 ARRI LogC3 视频曲线、87 款阿莱 Look 和定向收音枪麦；Magic9 则加入方形画幅前置摄像头及 3 秒电影 Live。两款机型侧重拍摄，超能版侧重长续航和散热。

MagicPad 4 使用 12.1 英寸 165Hz 屏幕、第四代骁龙 8s 和 10100mAh 电池，售价 3299 元起。手表 6 Pro 主打心脏停搏监测与无感血压 2.0；相关健康功能须按荣耀说明加入研究项目使用。

🔗 相关阅读：百万阿莱失踪案｜荣耀Magic9 Pro Max 首发评测
title_en: Honor Launches Magic9 Series Starting at 4,499 RMB, Alongside MagicPad 4 and Watch 6 Pro
content_en:
Honor has officially launched its Magic9 smartphone series, which includes the Magic9, Magic9 Pro Max, and Magic9 Super Edition. The lineup is now available for purchase, with prices starting at 4,499 RMB.

The series differentiates its models through camera capabilities, battery life, and form factors. The flagship Magic9 Pro Max features professional-grade imaging tools, including the ARRI LogC3 video curve, 87 ARRI Look profiles, and a directional shotgun microphone. The standard Magic9 introduces a square-format front camera and a 3-second "Movie Live" feature. Meanwhile, the Super Edition prioritizes extended battery life and advanced thermal management.

In addition to the smartphones, Honor introduced the MagicPad 4 tablet and the Watch 6 Pro. The MagicPad 4 starts at 3,299 RMB, boasting a 12.1-inch 165Hz display, a Snapdragon 8s processor, and a 10,100mAh battery. The Watch 6 Pro focuses on health tracking, offering cardiac arrest monitoring and cuffless blood pressure 2.0 tracking, though these features require users to opt into Honor's health research programs.

title_zh: 智界 RX 正式上市，余承东：鸿蒙智行「最好开的车」来了
content_zh:
智界 RX 9 月 28 日正式上市。它在方向盘上设置 BOOST 按键，按下后可调用专属加速踏板标定和底盘调校；另一枚「A」键为未来 L3 自动驾驶功能预留接口，并不代表该功能已经开放。鸿蒙智行同场还推出智界 R7 焕新款，并开启享界 V8 预订。发布会主要产品线如下：

鸿蒙智行官网已开放智界 RX 预订入口。上述续航均为厂商公布的测试口径，实际表现取决于配置和使用条件。

🔗 相关阅读：余承东：鸿蒙智行「最好开的车」来了！智界 RX 上市，25.98 万元起
title_en: Luxeed RX Electric SUV Officially Launches, Starting at 259,800 RMB
content_en:
Huawei's HarmonyOS Intelligent Mobility alliance has officially launched the Luxeed RX electric SUV, with prices starting at 259,800 RMB. Richard Yu, Chairman of Huawei's Smart Car Solutions BU, dubbed it the "best-driving car" in the HarmonyOS Intelligent Mobility lineup.

The Luxeed RX features a dedicated "BOOST" button on the steering wheel, which instantly activates custom acceleration calibration and chassis tuning for a sportier drive. Additionally, the steering wheel includes an "A" button reserved for future Level 3 autonomous driving capabilities, though this feature is not yet active.

Alongside the Luxeed RX launch, the alliance introduced an updated version of the Luxeed R7 and opened pre-orders for the Stelato V8 luxury sedan.

title_zh: 华为开源盘古 2.0 训练代码，预训练、SFT 与强化学习仓库上线
content_zh:
华为 9 月 28 日开放了 openPangu-2.0 的训练代码。Ascend Tribe 在 GitCode 上新增两个仓库：`openPangu-2.0-Training` 收录预训练和监督微调（SFT）代码，`openPangu-2.0-RL` 收录强化学习代码，均标示采用 Apache-2.0 许可证。

这次开放的是训练环节。华为此前分别在 6 月和 7 月发布了 openPangu-2.0-Flash 与 Pro 的模型权重和基础推理代码，并表示后续会逐步放出更多组件。新仓库让开发者能够查看相关训练实现，但仓库页面目前只展示简短说明，尚不能据此断言模型训练全过程已经可以独立复现。
title_en: Huawei Open-Sources Pangu 2.0 Training Code, Releasing Pre-training, SFT, and RL Repositories
content_en:
Huawei has open-sourced the training code for its openPangu-2.0 large language model. The Ascend Tribe team has launched two new repositories on GitCode under the Apache-2.0 license: `openPangu-2.0-Training`, which contains pre-training and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) code, and `openPangu-2.0-RL`, which hosts reinforcement learning code.

This release focuses on the training phase of the model. It follows Huawei's release of the model weights and basic inference code for the openPangu-2.0-Flash and Pro models earlier this summer.

While the new repositories allow developers to inspect Huawei's training implementations, the repository pages currently only feature brief descriptions. As a result, it remains unclear whether developers can fully and independently replicate the entire model training process at this stage.

title_zh: 大疆预告面向北京用户的无人机专属托管服务
content_zh:
大疆服务 9 月 28 日在小红书发布「致飞友：北京无人机专属托管服务预告」，表示将面向北京消费级无人机用户推出专属托管服务。这则预告以《北京市无人驾驶航空器管理规定》为背景，大疆帮助中心也已列出同名说明。

托管地点、费用、申请条件与启用时间仍须以大疆进一步公布的细则为准。预告本身不等于服务已经开放办理。
title_en: DJI Teases Exclusive Drone Hosting Service for Beijing Users
content_en:
DJI has teased a new, exclusive drone hosting service tailored for consumer drone users in Beijing. Announced on social media platform Xiaohongshu, the initiative aligns with the latest "Beijing Unmanned Aircraft Management Regulations."

While the service has been officially previewed, DJI noted that key details—including hosting locations, fees, eligibility criteria, and the official launch date—will be shared in future announcements. The service is not yet open for registration.

title_zh: 千问接入夸克网盘，可按授权读取和整理个人文件
content_zh:
昨天，千问 App 官宣与夸克网盘打通，用户授权即可在千问中查询和整理网盘资料，并基于文件生成复习资料、工作总结或照片合集。

夸克网盘官网也已把「在千问等 Agent 中安装使用」列为网盘能力，并提供一句话备份、查找和整理文件的入口。
title_en: Alibaba's Qwen AI Integrates with Quark Drive for Smart File Management
content_en:
Alibaba's Qwen (Tongyi Qianwen) AI app has officially integrated with Quark Drive. With user authorization, the AI assistant can now access, search, and organize files stored on the cloud drive.

This integration allows users to leverage Qwen to automatically generate study guides, work summaries, or photo collections directly from their stored documents. Quark has also updated its platform to list Qwen integration as a core capability, offering quick prompts for file backups and organization.

title_zh: 荣耀推出磁吸墨水屏阅读器 S3，售价 359 元
content_zh:
荣耀 HONOR Life 墨水屏阅读器 S3 9 月 28 日上架，机身重约 61g、厚约 5.6mm，可磁吸在手机背面使用，售价 359 元。它采用 3.68 英寸墨水屏，像素密度为 259PPI，点击屏幕即可翻页。

这款设备支持通过 Wi-Fi 6 和荣耀智慧空间 App 传书，兼容 epub、pdf、mobi、doc、docx、txt 等格式，并可用 TF 卡扩展存储。荣耀标称其连续离线阅读时间为 30 小时。
title_en: Honor Launches S3 Magnetic E-Ink Reader for 359 Yuan
content_en:
Honor has officially launched the HONOR Life E-Ink Reader S3, priced at 359 RMB. Designed for ultimate portability, the device weighs just 61 grams, measures 5.6mm in thickness, and can magnetically attach to the back of a smartphone.

The reader features a 3.68-inch e-ink display with a pixel density of 259 PPI. It supports Wi-Fi 6, file transfers via the Honor Smart Space app, and is compatible with major formats including EPUB, PDF, MOBI, and TXT. Additionally, it supports TF card storage expansion and boasts up to 30 hours of continuous offline reading.

title_zh: 电车维修费引热议：1.7 倍是事故车维修统计
content_zh:
9 月 28 日，「电车买得起修不起」相关话题登上微博热搜。界面新闻提到，一则电池包外壳卡扣损坏、维修时被要求更换整个电池包的车主案例再次传播；这起个案的报价与责任认定尚缺车企或保险文件的独立核对。

热议中引用的「1.7 倍」来自 J.D. Power 8 月 6 日发布的《2026 年中国新能源汽车售后服务满意度研究》，对比的是新能源事故车与燃油车的维修费，并非日常保养开销，也不是 9 月 28 日新公布的数据。报告还指出，新能源车主出险后的服务满意度比事故维修总体人群低 67 分。

商务部等 9 部门 6 月发布的文件要求车企丰富新能源汽车维修和配件渠道，引导整车与电池企业开放维修技术授权，鼓励「以修代换」。
title_en: High EV Repair Costs Spark Debate: "1.7x" Figure Refers to Accident Damage, Not Routine Maintenance
content_en:
On September 28, the topic "EVs are affordable to buy but unaffordable to repair" trended on Chinese social media platform Weibo. The discussion was partly fueled by a resurfaced case of an electric vehicle owner who was reportedly asked to replace an entire battery pack simply because a casing clip was damaged. However, the quote and liability details for this case have not been independently verified.

Much of the online debate cited a "1.7 times" cost difference, which originates from a J.D. Power report released on August 6. The study compared the repair costs of accident-damaged new energy vehicles (NEVs) against traditional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles, rather than routine maintenance expenses. The report also highlighted that NEV owners' satisfaction after filing insurance claims was 67 points lower than the average for all accident repairs.

To address these rising concerns, nine Chinese government departments, including the Ministry of Commerce, issued a directive in June. The policy urges automakers to expand NEV repair and spare parts channels, encourages vehicle and battery manufacturers to license their repair technologies, and promotes "repairing instead of replacing" components.

title_zh: 京东 101HOME 上海首店开业，推出 33 个实景「梦想之家」
content_zh:
京东 101HOME 全球首店 9 月 28 日在上海静安寺商圈开业。京东此前公布，门店约 1.2 万平方米、共四层，将家具家居、智能科技、设计服务、餐饮与艺术空间放在同一场所；消费者可在场景中看商品并直接下单。

门店的 33 个「梦想之家」按不同家庭结构和生活方式布置，参与设计的包括 Kelly Hoppen、青山周平和本间贵史。京东称，店内汇集逾 1000 个家居与生活方式品牌、超过 1.5 万件商品，其中 30 余个国际品牌首次进入中国市场。
title_en: JD.com Debuts First 101HOME Flagship in Shanghai with 33 Immersive "Dream Homes"
content_en:
JD.com officially opened its first global "101HOME" store in Shanghai's bustling Jing'an Temple commercial district on September 28. Spanning approximately 12,000 square meters across four floors, the mega-store integrates home furniture, smart technology, interior design services, dining, and art spaces, allowing customers to experience products in real-life settings and make purchases on the spot.

The store features 33 "Dream Homes" tailored to various family structures and lifestyles. Renowned international designers, including Kelly Hoppen, Shuhei Aoyama, and Takashi Honma, participated in designing these curated spaces.

According to JD.com, the flagship store brings together over 1,000 home and lifestyle brands, offering more than 15,000 products. Notably, over 30 international brands are making their official debut in the Chinese market through this launch.

title_zh: 《野性的呼唤》将拍 AI 改编电影，《哈利·波特》制片人加入
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，参与制作过六部《哈利·波特》电影的英国制片人 David Barron，将担任杰克·伦敦小说《野性的呼唤》新电影的制片人。新片由 Simon Rumley 编剧并执导，计划在 nmatic 使用生成式 AI 制作画面，复杂场景再结合 CGI 与传统视觉特效。

制作团队希望从雪橇犬巴克的主观视角讲述故事：它从加州的家庭生活被带往 19 世纪 90 年代的克朗代克淘金地，逐渐找回野性。小说曾多次改编，上一部广为人知的电影版于 2020 年上映，由哈里森·福特出演。
title_en: "Harry Potter" Producer Joins AI-Powered Adaptation of "The Call of the Wild"
content_en:
British producer David Barron, renowned for his work on six *Harry Potter* films, has signed on to produce a new film adaptation of Jack London's classic novel *The Call of the Wild*, according to Deadline. The upcoming project will be written and directed by Simon Rumley.

In a modern twist, the production plans to leverage generative AI through the tech studio nmatic to generate visuals, while combining CGI and traditional visual effects for more complex scenes. The creative team aims to tell the story from the subjective perspective of Buck, the sled dog, as he transitions from a pampered life in California to the harsh Klondike Gold Rush of the 1890s, eventually rediscovering his wild instincts.

Jack London's 1903 novel has been adapted for the screen multiple times. The most recent major adaptation was released in 2020, starring Harrison Ford.

title_zh: 《戴帽子的猫》确认引进内地，档期待定
content_zh:
华纳兄弟电影发布的消息显示，苏斯博士童书改编动画《戴帽子的猫》将引进中国内地院线，具体上映日期尚未公布。影片是华纳兄弟影业动画制作的首部长篇动画电影，北美定于 11 月 6 日上映。

电影由 Bill Hader 为戴帽子的猫配音，Erica Rivinoja 与 Alessandro Carloni 执导。故事中，戴帽子的猫受命帮助搬到陌生小镇的姐弟 Gabby 和 Sebastian 重新振作；官方还公布了 Matt Berry、Quinta Brunson、Bowen Yang 等配音演员。
title_en: Animated Feature 'The Cat in the Hat' Confirmed for Mainland China Release
content_en:
Warner Bros. Pictures has announced that its upcoming animated feature *The Cat in the Hat*, based on the beloved Dr. Seuss children's book, will be released in theaters across mainland China. While the official Chinese release date has yet to be announced, the film is scheduled to hit North American theaters on November 6.

This project marks the debut feature-length animated film produced by Warner Bros. Pictures Animation. Directed by Erica Rivinoja and Alessandro Carloni, the story follows the iconic Cat in the Hat as he helps siblings Gabby and Sebastian cheer up and find their footing after moving to a new, unfamiliar town.

The film boasts a star-studded voice cast, with Bill Hader voicing the titular character. Other confirmed cast members lending their voices to the film include Matt Berry, Quinta Brunson, and Bowen Yang.

title_zh: 2026 年 MTV 音乐录影带大奖揭晓
content_zh:
2026 年 MTV 音乐录影带大奖于美国当地时间 9 月 27 日晚举行。主办方公布的完整获奖名单显示，麦当娜以七奖成为当晚获奖最多的艺人，拿下年度艺人、最佳舞曲等类别；泰勒·斯威夫特凭《The Fate of Ophelia》获得年度音乐录影带，并获颁首届艺人导演荣誉。

名单中，LISA 凭与坂口健太郎合作的《Dream》获得最佳流行音乐录影带，BTS 的《Swim》获年度歌曲和最佳 K-pop 音乐录影带。斯威夫特还凭《Opalite》获得最佳导演奖。
title_en: Madonna and Taylor Swift Dominate the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards
content_en:
The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards (VMAs) took place on the evening of September 27, celebrating the year's biggest achievements in music videos. Madonna emerged as the night's biggest winner, taking home seven awards, including Artist of the Year and Best Dance.

Taylor Swift also enjoyed a historic night, winning Video of the Year for "The Fate of Ophelia" and Best Director for "Opalite." Additionally, she was honored with the inaugural Artist-Director award, recognizing her outstanding creative vision behind the camera.

Other major highlights of the night included LISA winning Best Pop for "Dream," her collaboration with Kentaro Sakaguchi. Meanwhile, K-pop sensation BTS secured both Song of the Year and Best K-Pop for their hit single "Swim."
